subject: School Committee Re-election Platform
overview: Aaron Olapade outlined his first-term accomplishments and platform priorities for his re-election campaign to the Medford School Committee. He focused on disability inclusion, expanded academic pathways, and student social-emotional health.

items.title: First Term Reflections
items.summary: Olapade described his first term as a period of listening to constituents and learning how to navigate administrative systems to support student needs.

items.title: Best Buddies Program and DEI
items.summary: He highlighted a partnership with Medford CPAC to secure a Best Buddies program for students with disabilities and advocated for non-weaponized diversity, equity, and inclusion policies.

items.title: Search Committee Participation
items.summary: Olapade reviewed his service on search committees for the Athletic Director and English Learners department leadership.

items.title: Dual Enrollment Program Proposal
items.summary: He proposed establishing dual enrollment partnerships with local community colleges to allow high school students to earn college credits and experience higher education.

items.title: Staff Recruitment and Educator Pipelines
items.summary: The candidate emphasized improving internal programs to encourage students to pursue careers in education and addressing teacher burnout.

items.title: Student Socialization and Communication
items.summary: Olapade addressed the need for programs that improve student communication and self-advocacy skills following the social impacts of the COVID-19 pandemic.
